jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Project Manager based in Brazil.

In this role, you will take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of complex Cloud, Data, and AI professional services projects, supporting clients across Brazil and Canada. You will oversee multiple concurrent engagements, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget. Combining strategic project leadership with financial management and resource planning, you will play a key role in driving successful technology transformations. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams, customers, sales professionals, and senior business stakeholders to align expectations and delivery objectives. Acting as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact, you will provide executive-level updates in both Portuguese and English. This is an opportunity to contribute to high-impact technology initiatives within an international consulting environment while taking significant ownership of project performance and customer satisfaction.

Accountabilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of multiple Cloud, Data, and AI projects, from sales handoff and project initiation through execution, customer acceptance, and final closeout.
Collaborate with Sales and technical teams to define project scope, deliverables, timelines, resource requirements, and customer expectations.
Develop, maintain, and monitor comprehensive project plans, milestones, budgets, resource allocations, and delivery schedules.
Take full ownership of project financial performance, including budget monitoring, cost control, resource utilization, hours management, and capacity planning.
Establish and manage project governance frameworks, including status reporting, risk assessment, issue resolution, escalation procedures, and change control.
Identify potential scope changes, delivery challenges, and project risks early, implementing proactive mitigation strategies to protect timelines, budgets, and customer commitments.
Coordinate cross-functional engineering and delivery teams across Brazil and Canada, ensuring effective collaboration and alignment.
Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, project stakeholders, technical teams, and executive leadership.
Prepare and deliver clear executive-level project updates in Portuguese and English, communicating progress, financial performance, risks, challenges, and strategic recommendations.
Manage customer expectations, facilitate key decisions, and maintain transparency throughout the project lifecycle.
Drive customer acceptance, ensure successful project closure, and identify opportunities to improve delivery processes and operational efficiency.
Promote accountability, effective communication, and continuous improvement across all project engagements.

Requirements

7+ years of professional experience in IT project management, including at least 3 years in consulting or professional services environments managing multiple client engagements.
Proven track record of successfully delivering complex technology projects, ideally involving cloud infrastructure, data platforms, artificial intelligence, or digital transformation.
Demonstrated experience managing project financial performance, including budgets, cost tracking, resource allocation, capacity planning, and project profitability.
Strong experience overseeing multiple concurrent projects, balancing competing priorities, and coordinating cross-functional technical teams.
Solid understanding of AWS, Data, and AI technologies at a project management level, with the ability to communicate effectively with engineering and technical stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Excel, Google Sheets, Google Workspace, and Confluence.
Familiarity with Professional Services Automation (PSA) platforms such as Productive or equivalent tools for project financial tracking and resource management.
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to present project progress, financial updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and customers.
Professional proficiency in both Portuguese and English, written and spoken.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, combined with a proactive and results-oriented approach.
Ability to work independently, demonstrate ownership, make informed decisions, and manage complex delivery environments.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in a relevant field.

Nice To Have

PMP or Agile project management certifications.
AWS certifications, such as AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, AWS Certified AI Practitioner, or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.
Previous experience working with AWS Partners, cloud consulting firms, systems integrators, or technology transformation companies.
Experience using Productive or similar Professional Services Automation platforms for financial tracking, project management, and resource allocation.
MBA or postgraduate qualifications in business, technology, or project management.
Professional proficiency in Spanish.

Benefits

Fully remote work: 100% remote position for candidates based in Brazil.
International exposure: Opportunity to manage technology engagements and collaborate with customers and teams across Brazil and Canada.
Professional development: Work on impactful Cloud, Data, AI, and digital transformation initiatives.
Leadership and ownership: Take responsibility for complex projects, financial performance, resource management, and customer relationships.
Collaborative environment: Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering, sales, and business teams.
Employment type: Full-time position.
Working hours: São Paulo time zone, with required overlap with Canadian business hours (specific arrangements to be confirmed).
Start date: As soon as possible.
Availability: Candidates should ideally have a maximum notice period of 2–3 weeks following offer acceptance.
Location requirement: Candidates must be based in Brazil.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process
to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice:
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: AVP, Project Manager
jobs.description:
Department

Affordable Housing | Equity - Acquisitions

We are Walker & Dunlop. We are one of the largest providers of capital to the commercial real estate industry, enabling real estate owners and operators to bring their visions of communities — where people live, work, shop, and play — to life. We are committed to creating meaningful social, environmental, and economic change in our communities.

Department Overview

W&D Affordable Equity (formerly Alliant Capital)
is a leading tax credit firm focused on tax credit syndication for the development and financing of affordable multifamily rental housing. As a syndicator of Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), W&D Affordable Equity raises corporate equity and monitors the development, construction, lease-up, and permanent financing phases of its investments. With a dedicated team of experienced real estate, asset management, legal, and tax professionals, we provide the highest level of fully integrated real estate and investment support services.

The Impact You Will Have

Reporting to the VP, Project Manager, the AVP, Project Manager is responsible for managing the acquisition of limited partnership interests in affordable housing developments. As a member of an acquisitions pod, this role manages assigned LIHTC transactions from underwriting and due diligence through closing, ensuring thorough financial analysis, effective risk mitigation, and timely execution. The AVP works closely with developers, investors, and internal stakeholders to advance transactions, coordinate deliverables, and develop sound investment recommendations. As part of a growing business within Walker & Dunlop, this position offers the opportunity to take ownership of complex transactions, strengthen technical expertise, and contribute to the continued growth and success of the platform.

Primary Responsibilities

Manage assigned LIHTC transactions from underwriting and due diligence through closing, ensuring timely execution and adherence to established investment and transaction processes.
Lead negotiations of project partnership agreements with developers, collaborating with the VP, Project Manager on complex transaction matters as appropriate.
Conduct and review financial feasibility analyses, including construction sources and uses, operating budgets, projected income, and permanent financing structures.
Review and negotiate loan and financing documents with multiple lenders, including conventional and tax-exempt lenders.
Evaluate key due diligence materials, including tax credit applications, market studies, appraisals, environmental reports, title, survey, and regulatory approvals.
Manage transaction timelines and coordinate cross-functional efforts with underwriting, construction, modeling, legal, and asset management teams to facilitate successful closings.
Serve as the primary point of contact for developers on assigned transactions and respond to investor and internal inquiries regarding transaction status.
Coordinate transaction activities and deliverables with Acquisitions Coordinators and other team members, ensuring accuracy, quality, and adherence to established underwriting and transaction processes.
Prepare Project Acquisition Reports (PARs), including investment rationale, key transaction risks and mitigants, and recommended deal structures; present transactions to the Investment Committee for approval and support investor investment decisions through presentations and responses to due diligence inquiries.
Proactively identify and address financial, legal, development, and transaction risks, collaborating with internal stakeholders and external partners to develop appropriate mitigation strategies and escalating complex matters as needed.
Ensure complete, accurate, and compliant maintenance of project due diligence files.
Collaborate with the VP, Project Manager to identify opportunities to improve transaction execution, team coordination, and established processes.
Perform other duties as assigned
Attendance is generally required from 8:30 am – 5:30 pm local time, Tuesday through Thursday, with the option to work remotely on Mondays and Fridays.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree required.
6+ years of experience in real estate finance, development, or affordable housing transactions.
Demonstrated experience underwriting and structuring real estate transactions, preferably in LIHTC investments.
Experience managing transactions and coordinating activities with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with escrow processes, title, and survey review preferred

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Strong understanding of real estate development, finance, and LIHTC transactions.
Advanced financial analysis skills with high proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
Strong negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to effectively engage developers, investors, and internal stakeholders.
Ability to independently manage multiple complex transactions in a deadline-driven environment.
Strong organizational and project management skills, including the ability to coordinate deliverables, manage competing priorities, and maintain accountability for assigned transactions.
Sound business judgment and ability to assess, mitigate, and appropriately escalate transaction risks.
Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and contribute to shared business objectives.
High degree of professionalism and discretion.
Ability to show ownership of your work, embrace challenges and growth opportunities, and demonstrate patience when learning new processes.
Demonstrates courtesy, respect, and thoughtfulness when teaming with colleagues and collaborating with stakeholders.

This position has an estimated base salary of $125,000 - $150,000 plus a discretionary bonus. An employment offer is based on the applicant’s relevant work experience, applicable knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and alignment with market data.

BN1

What We Offer

The opportunity to join one of Fortune Magazine’s Great Places to Work winners
Comprehensive benefit options* that have earned Walker & Dunlop the gold level of the 2025 Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation™, some of which include:
Up to 83% subsidized medical payroll deductions
Competitive dental and vision benefits
401(k) + match
Pre-tax transit and commuting benefits
A robust health and wellness program – earn cash rewards and gain access to resources that

promote health, engagement, and balance

Paid maternity and parental leave, as well as other family paid leave programs
Company-paid life, short and long-term disability insurance
Health Savings Account and Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending
Career development opportunities
Empowerment and encouragement to give back – volunteer hours and donation matching
Eligibility may vary based on average number of hours worked

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

We are committed to equity in all steps of the recruitment and employment experience. We believe in equal access to opportunities in our workplace. We do not tolerate discrimination, including harassment, based on any characteristic protected by applicable law, such as race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, sex, age, disability, veteran or military status, and genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We strive to be a safe place to ask questions, build professional relationships, and develop careers.

Please call us at 301.215.5500, if you have any concerns about information requested during or after the application process.

Fair Chance Hiring

We will consider for employment qualified applicants regardless of arrest and conviction records, in accordance with federal, state, and local laws.

jobs.title: Project Manager I
jobs.description:
Description

Leidos Engineering has an opportunity for a Project Manager I (PM I)
who will work alongside lead engineers and account managers supporting substation engineering projects for various electric utility clients throughout the Northern United States. The PM will be part of an established team within our Power Delivery Solutions (PDS) division. PDS provides consulting services to public-owned and investor-owned electric utilities for comprehensive engineering design of electrical transmission, substation, and distribution projects nationwide.

This position supports a hybrid work environment, with an expectation of regular in-office collaboration with engineering and project management teams. This role can be performed from Walled Lake MI, Pittsburgh PA or Chicago IL, depending on the location of the selected candidate.

As a Valued Team Member, You Can Look Forward To a Fast Paced, Diverse Work Environment And Flexible Work Arrangements, As Well As Managers Who Will Encourage Career Development And Growth Opportunities, Including

Project Management Professional (PMP)
Leadership training
Formal Mentorship programs
Management opportunities
Learning & Development Resources

Primary Responsibilities

Independently lead project teams to complete engineering designs of various sized electric infrastructure projects for electric utilities
Accept responsibility for overall project performance and reporting
Manage project costs, schedule and scope within approved limits, including the development of recovery plans when needed
Ensure contract compliance
Drive work products by coordinating and working with Engineering Leads and Managers to track and execute client deliverables
Ensure and document adherence to the quality control process
Interface directly with the client and internal management to solve issues and report progress, costs, schedule adherence and risks across a program of projects
Communicate with clients, internal project teams, multiple engineering disciplines, functional leaders, subcontractors, and support personnel
Prepare bid documents; Develop cost estimates and responses to Requests for Proposal
Complete monthly invoices, accruals, and accounts receivable within prescribed time frames
Identify business development opportunities

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance or a closely related discipline is required
A minimum of three (3) + years of relevant Project Management experience
Experience with project management software (e.g., MS Project, P6)
Demonstrated experience managing and reporting project financial performance, budgets, proposals, scopes and schedules
Must have the capability to plan, organize, direct, and track technical efforts on project tasks
Ability to work effectively in a team environment
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Must be able to interact with customer representatives in an effective manner
Excellent organizational and problem solving skills and the ability to multi-task effectively
Experience with MS Office Software (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Periodic travel (less than 2%); Candidates should possess a valid US driver's license
Hybrid office attendance (2-3 days in office, remaining days work from home) in one of the following offices: Walled Lake, MI; Pittsburgh PA; Chicago, IL

Preferred Qualifications

PMP Certification
Familiarity with electric power infrastructure projects and knowledge of business issues associated with power delivery services
Demonstrated success with a team approach to the consulting business
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel

At Leidos, We pride ourselves on being a trusted and technology-focused solutions provider. We've worked with over 50 investor-owned utilities, over 160 municipals/cooperatives, and we're continuing to expand our reach. Plus, we've got an amazing group of industry-leading construction partners who help us deliver meaningful Energy Delivery Solutions. Our recognition as an industry leader has been confirmed time and time again. Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked Leidos among the Top 10 T&D Firms and Top 10 Power Firms.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

Original Posting

November 2, 2026

For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.

Pay Range

Pay Range $73,450.00 - $132,775.00

The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.

About Leidos

Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.

Pay And Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.

Securing Your Data

Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.

Commitment to Non-Discrimination

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. W&D Affordable Equity (formerly Alliant Capital)

As a syndicator of Low-Income Housing Tax Credits (LIHTC), W&D Affordable Equity raises corporate equity and monitors the development, construction, lease-up, and permanent financing phases of its investments. With a dedicated team of experienced real estate, asset management, legal, and tax professionals, we provide the highest level of fully integrated real estate and investment support services.

The Impact You Will Have

Reporting to the VP, Project Manager, the AVP, Project Manager is responsible for managing the acquisition of limited partnership interests in affordable housing developments. As a member of an acquisitions pod, this role manages assigned LIHTC transactions from underwriting and due diligence through closing, ensuring thorough financial analysis, effective risk mitigation, and timely execution. The AVP works closely with developers, investors, and internal stakeholders to advance transactions, coordinate deliverables, and develop sound investment recommendations. As part of a growing business within Walker & Dunlop, this position offers the opportunity to take ownership of complex transactions, strengthen technical expertise, and contribute to the continued growth and success of the platform.

Experience managing transactions and coordinating activities with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with escrow processes, title, and survey review preferred

Strong understanding of real estate development, finance, and LIHTC transactions.

Design and implement supply, logistics, and maintenance solutions that optimize aircraft readiness, fleet availability, and lifecycle cost.

Provide expert input to risk analyses and contingency plans addressing logistics, maintenance, and supply chain risks in forward-deployed and austere environments.

Experience with risk management and mitigation strategies specific to aerospace defense projects.
Proficiency in program management tools and methodologies applicable to defense and aerospace industries.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field.
Experience managing programs in aerospace defense and space sectors.
Strong leadership and decision-making skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities tailored to complex defense projects.
Adaptability to dynamic environments and passion for continuous improvement and innovation.
7 years of experience or knowledge of the Aerospace industry specifically in navigation

Strong communication (oral and written) and executive presentation skills

As a leader who helped shape the industry, Draganfly’s focus is on the sale of drone products and services, contract engineering & custom integration product development, and health monitoring products and services.

Additional information on our expertise, projects, and culture can be found at https://draganfly.com/

About The Role

Draganfly is seeking a Project Manager to lead the planning and execution of customer-facing, technical, and cross-functional projects across the organization. This role will serve as a primary point of coordination between customers, Engineering, Operations, Sales, Field Operations, Logistics, and other internal stakeholders to ensure projects are clearly defined, properly resourced, effectively managed, and successfully delivered.

The ideal candidate is an experienced project manager with the technical aptitude to work effectively alongside engineering and technical teams without needing to serve as the subject matter expert. This individual will manage multiple concurrent projects, communicate directly with customers and partners, coordinate cross-functional teams, and maintain strong execution throughout the project lifecycle. This role reports directly to the PMO Lead and works closely with Program Managers, functional leaders, technical teams, subject-matter experts, cross-functional teams, and Project Coordinators.

Key Responsibilities

Project Leadership & Delivery

Lead assigned customer-facing, technical, integration, special, and cross-functional projects from initiation through delivery and closeout.
Establish and maintain project objectives, scope, schedules, milestones, risks, dependencies, stakeholders, and acceptance criteria.
Develop project plans aligned with the complexity, risk, and delivery requirements of each initiative.
Maintain accountability for assigned projects while coordinating work across multiple functional teams.
Monitor project progress, resource requirements, schedules, and deliverables to support successful execution.
Identify and address project risks, constraints, schedule impacts, and resource requirements in collaboration with the appropriate stakeholders.
Manage multiple concurrent projects while maintaining clear priorities and consistent stakeholder communication.
Support internal Engineering projects as portfolio capacity permits.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary project-management point of contact for assigned customers, partners, and external stakeholders.
Facilitate customer and technical meetings to define requirements, integration needs, delivery expectations, and acceptance criteria.
Translate technical project progress into clear customer-facing updates while enabling Engineering personnel to remain focused on technical execution.
Coordinate with Engineering and technical subject matter experts to obtain accurate information and resolve customer questions.
Communicate project updates, changes, decisions, and milestones professionally and transparently.
Maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Coordinate project activities across Engineering, Operations, Field Operations, Sales/Business Development, Logistics, Procurement, and other functional teams.
Establish clear ownership of project deliverables, actions, dependencies, and handoffs.
Facilitate internal project meetings to review progress, priorities, risks, and upcoming milestones.
Coordinate technical requirements between customers and internal teams while supporting efficient use of technical resources.
Ensure appropriate stakeholders are engaged at each stage of the project lifecycle.
Support the execution of special initiatives that span multiple organizational functions.

Demo, Training & Event Oversight

Maintain project-level accountability for assigned demonstrations, customer trainings, trade shows, and operational events.
Coordinate personnel, equipment, logistics, customer requirements, and readiness activities leading up to execution.
Partner with Project Coordinators to ensure event intake, scheduling, calendar management, readiness tracking, logistics follow-up, and administrative requirements are completed.
Monitor project readiness, customer requirements, schedule alignment, and operational planning.
Support pre-event and customer planning activities as required.

Who Are You Really?

You are a highly organized project leader who can manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and workstreams in a fast-paced environment.
You communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, technical teams, and senior stakeholders.
You take ownership, exercise sound judgment, follow through on commitments, and solve problems proactively.
You can influence and coordinate cross-functional contributors who do not directly report to you.
You have the technical aptitude to understand discussions, identify requirements and risks, and drive follow-up actions without needing to be the subject matter expert.
You are comfortable balancing customer expectations with technical, operational, resource, and schedule constraints.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in project management, business administration, engineering, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
Demonstrated experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, functional teams, or workstreams.
Strong project-management fundamentals, including scope, schedule, risk, dependency, stakeholder, and issue management.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to communicate professionally with customers and external stakeholders.
Ability to organize and manage multiple concurrent priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Strong judgment, ownership, follow-through, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to influence and coordinate personnel who do not directly report to the Project Manager.
Ability to understand technical discussions sufficiently to identify requirements, dependencies, risks, and follow-up actions.
Comfortable using project-management and collaboration software.
Ability and willingness to travel as required in support of customer engagements, project execution, demonstrations, integrations, validation activities, and other business needs.

Preferred Qualifications & Certifications

PMP certification or demonstrated progress toward PMP certification.
Experience working in aerospace, unmanned aircraft systems (UAS), robotics, engineering, or another technical environment.
Experience managing technical integration, product-development, or customer-delivery projects.
Experience working directly with engineers and technical subject matter experts.
Experience supporting government, military, public-safety, or enterprise customers.
Experience using ClickUp or a comparable project-management platform.
General technical aptitude across mechanical, electrical, software, communications, aviation, or related technology areas.

Compensation Package

Competitive salary: $80,000–$100,000 USD
Health Coverage Reimbursement: We reimburse the cost of your existing or preferred healthcare plan (amount varies depending on family size).
401(k) program with employer matching
Generous time-off program, including vacation, wellness days, and the week off between Christmas and New Year’s.
Professional development support, including assistance in obtaining or maintaining role-relevant certifications (e.g., PMP certification, where applicable).

Why Join Us?

At Draganfly Innovations, you’ll join a collaborative team that values innovation, curiosity, and continuous improvement. We’re in an exciting growth phase, scaling our technologies, product lines, and teams as we continue to shape the future of UAV innovation. Joining us now means becoming part of a company with deep roots in the industry - and bold ambitions for what comes next.

You’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, work on diverse and cutting‑edge projects, and grow your skills alongside passionate experts. We offer competitive compensation, strong benefits, and a supportive environment where your contributions truly matter. Here, you won’t just join a company - you’ll help build what comes next. As part of our hiring process, all candidates must successfully complete reference checks and a criminal background check.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Leader
jobs.description:
VinFast là một thương hiệu Việt Nam, cam kết theo đuổi tầm nhìn trở thành thương hiệu xe điện thông minh toàn cầu. VinFast đã đặt nền móng cho ngành công nghiệp ô tô điện và xe máy điện tại Việt Nam, đồng thời tích cực thúc đẩy cuộc cách mạng xe điện trên toàn thế giới.

Với triết lý lấy khách hàng làm trung tâm, VinFast không ngừng đổi mới và hội tụ các giá trị trí tuệ để tạo ra những sản phẩm đẳng cấp hàng đầu, giá cả phải chăng cùng dịch vụ hậu mãi vượt trội. Bên cạnh đó, VinFast mang đến cho mọi người cơ hội tiếp cận xe điện thông minh, đồng thời góp phần xây dựng một tương lai xanh, thông minh và bền vững.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm
Trưởng phòng Nghiệp vụ sản phẩm
chịu trách nhiệm dẫn dắt toàn bộ hoạt động phân tích nghiệp vụ cho các nhóm sản phẩm/ứng dụng AI trên xe: Trợ lý ảo trên ô tô điện VinFast và các sản phẩm AI liên quan dữ liệu. Vai trò này chuyển định hướng sản phẩm và nhu cầu người dùng thành hệ thống tài liệu yêu cầu rõ ràng, khả thi và đo lường được (PRD, Use Case, User Story, đặc tả dữ liệu/AI, tiêu chí nghiệm thu); đồng thời là đầu mối phối hợp với đội kỹ thuật (AI/LLM, Data Platform, Android Automotive, Backend), UX/UI và các đối tác trong - ngoài Tập đoàn. Bên cạnh công việc chuyên môn, vị trí chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng chuẩn nghiệp vụ, quy trình làm việc và năng lực cho đội ngũ BA của Phòng.

A. Nghiệp vụ sản phẩm Trợ lý ảo

1. Dẫn dắt đội ngũ BA thu thập, phân tích và quản lý yêu cầu cho sản phẩm - AI Voice Assistant trên ô tô điện VinFast, bao phủ các nhóm tính năng: điều khiển xe, dẫn đường, giải trí, tìm kiếm thông tin và trợ giúp cá nhân.

2. Chuyển định hướng sản phẩm thành PRD, Use Case, User Story, luồng hội thoại (conversation flow), luồng nghiệp vụ (workflow) và tiêu chí nghiệm thu cụ thể cho từng phiên bản phát hành.

3. Đặc tả yêu cầu cho các thành phần AI của trợ lý ảo: nhận diện ý định (NLU/intent), gọi công cụ (tool/function calling), kịch bản agent, quy tắc an toàn nội dung (guardrail) và cơ chế xử lý khi hệ thống hiểu sai.

4. Đảm bảo mọi yêu cầu gắn với trải nghiệm trong xe: an toàn khi lái, độ trễ phản hồi, tính tự nhiên của hội thoại và khả năng hoạt động khi mất kết nối.

5. Phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội kỹ thuật (AI/Dev Engineer) và UX/UI để bảo đảm giải pháp khả thi về kỹ thuật và đúng chuẩn trải nghiệm HMI.

B. Nghiệp vụ AI cho bài toán dữ liệu

1. Xác định và đặc tả các bài toán AI/dữ liệu: cá nhân hóa gợi ý, dự báo nhu cầu, phát hiện bất thường trong vận hành xe và dịch vụ,…

2. Xây dựng yêu cầu nghiệp vụ cho toàn vòng đời dữ liệu: nguồn dữ liệu, kế hoạch thu thập sự kiện (event/tracking plan), tiêu chuẩn chất lượng dữ liệu và yêu cầu tuân thủ bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.

3. Làm việc với Data Engineer/Data Scientist để chuyển bài toán kinh doanh thành bài toán cụ thể: định nghĩa đầu vào/đầu ra, tiêu chí đánh giá (độ chính xác, precision/recall, độ trễ), phương án thử nghiệm A/B và điều kiện đưa vào vận hành.

4. Thiết kế và quản trị hệ thống báo cáo, dashboard đo lường sản phẩm (mức độ sử dụng, tỷ lệ quay lại, tỷ lệ thành công theo tính năng).

5. Đảm bảo dữ liệu thu thập và sử dụng đúng quy định pháp luật và chính sách riêng tư của Tập đoàn tại các thị trường triển khai.

C. Quản lý và phát triển đội ngũ

1. Quản lý, phân công và phát triển đội ngũ BA; xây dựng lộ trình năng lực, đào tạo và đánh giá hiệu quả công việc.

2. Chuẩn hóa quy trình phân tích nghiệp vụ, hệ thống tài liệu và công cụ quản trị yêu cầu; bảo đảm chất lượng đầu ra đồng nhất giữa các nhóm sản phẩm.

Requirements

Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các ngành: Hệ thống thông tin, CNTT, Khoa học dữ liệu, Toán - Thống kê, Kinh tế hoặc liên quan.

Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm phân tích nghiệp vụ/quản lý sản phẩm, trong đó có ít nhất 2 năm ở vai trò quản lý đội nhóm (Trưởng nhóm/Team Lead trở lên).

Có kinh nghiệm trực tiếp với ít nhất một trong hai mảng:

o Sản phẩm hội thoại – Chatbot/Voicebot/Voice Assistant.

o Sản phẩm dữ liệu – phân tích dữ liệu, BI, Machine Learning.

Thành thạo viết PRD, Use Case, User Story, Workflow, Wireframe và tiêu chí nghiệm thu.

Có năng lực làm việc trực tiếp với dữ liệu: đọc hiểu mô hình dữ liệu, viết được truy vấn SQL, sử dụng công cụ BI (Power BI/Tableau hoặc tương đương).

Hiểu biết về AI/LLM và vòng đời phát triển mô hình: dữ liệu huấn luyện, đánh giá chất lượng, giám sát sau triển khai.

Thành thạo các công cụ: Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, BPMN/UML.

Kỹ năng phân tích, tổng hợp, trình bày và thuyết phục; kỹ năng lãnh đạo đội nhóm và điều phối đa phòng ban.

Ưu tiên:

Kinh nghiệm với Generative AI, NLP, LLM, RAG hoặc hệ thống Agent.

Kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực Automotive, Android Automotive OS, IoT hoặc hệ thống nhúng.

Hiểu biết về quy định bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân (Nghị định 13/2023/NĐ-CP, GDPR/PDPA).

Có tư duy sản phẩm (product mindset), hiểu rõ vòng đời phát triển sản phẩm công nghệ.

Kinh nghiệm triển khai sản phẩm cho thị trường quốc tế (Ấn Độ, Indonesia…).

Khả năng giao tiếp tốt bằng tiếng Anh.

Benefits

Mức lương cạnh tranh

Gói chăm sóc sức khỏe cao cấp, bao gồm bảo hiểm PVI và khám sức khỏe định kỳ hằng năm

Lương tháng 13 và thưởng theo hiệu suất làm việc nhằm ghi nhận đóng góp của bạn

Hưởng ưu đãi khi sử dụng các dịch vụ trong hệ sinh thái Vingroup như Vinmec, Vinpearl, Vinschool…

Cơ hội hợp tác và học hỏi từ các chuyên gia hàng đầu trong lĩnh vực ô tô/robotics

jobs.description:
About Leaf Home

At Leaf Home, we are powered by people on a single mission to make homeownership easy. We’ve crafted a team of the very best to ensure we make a difference by winning every day. In addition to serving our customers, Leaf Home strives to build a welcoming and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be a certified Great Place to Work®
as well as a multi-year recipient of Top Workplaces
recognition.

From competitive medical benefits to people-focused committees like the Women’s Committee, Diversity & Inclusion Committee, and VetConnect, we are dedicated to making Leaf Home a workplace where you can win every day. Come grow your career with us.

Why Leaf Home

We Win
– Being driven every day to win is who we are

People Powered
– Recognized as a top Ohio and U.S. workplace by Great Place to Work®, Energage, and more

Family Feel with Enterprise-Level Resources
– You are important to us, and we’ve built a culture you’ll love

Support
– Inclusion, sustainability, and reliability surround everything we do

Personal Growth
– Dedicated to providing resources and encouragement for employee growth

Mobility
– Locations throughout the U.S. and Canada, with continued expansion

Position Summary:
The IT Business Analyst works with business leaders, cross-functional teams, subject matter experts, and technical resources to identify business needs and define technology solutions that support organizational goals. In partnership with the IT Product Owner, the IT Business Analyst gathers, analyzes, and documents business and system requirements, translating them into clear functional and technical specifications for development teams. The role serves as a liaison between stakeholders, internal application teams, and vendors to ensure enterprise systems, such as CRM, ERP/Accounting, HCM, and data platforms, deliver solutions that meet business needs and achieve intended outcomes.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Gathering & Analysis:

Partner with business stakeholders to understand business needs, pain points, and operational goals.
Elicit, analyze, and document business, functional, and system requirements.
Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements for technical teams.

Collaboration with Product Owner:

Work closely with the Product Owner to refine product backlog items and ensure requirements support product priorities and business outcomes.

Assist in breaking down features into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria.

Provide input on scope, dependencies, and implementation considerations during backlog refinement.

Documentation & Requirements Management:

Develop and maintain clear documentation, including user stories, functional specifications, process flows, and business rules.

Ensure requirements are complete, accurate, and aligned with stakeholder expectations.

Maintain traceability between business requirements, technical solutions, and delivered functionality.

Development Support:

Serve as a point of clarification for development teams during implementation.

Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and other agile ceremonies.

Help ensure that delivered solutions align with documented requirements.

Testing & Validation:

Support quality assurance and user acceptance testing (UAT) by validating that those solutions meet business and functional requirements.

Assist in developing test scenarios and validating system functionality.

Coordinate with stakeholders to confirm successful delivery of solutions.

Stakeholder Communication:

Act as a liaison between business teams, product owners, technical teams, and external vendors.

Communicate project updates, requirement changes, and potential impacts to stakeholders.

Facilitate workshops, requirement sessions, and stakeholder reviews when needed.

Enterprise Systems Support:

Contribute to the successful delivery and enhancement of enterprise applications such as CRM, ERP/Accounting, HCM, and data platforms.

Support system improvements that drive operational efficiency and business value.

Experience and Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s Degree preferred, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

2+ years of experience as a Business Analyst working on multiple projects at an intermediate level. 

Experience working on large scale projects as well as handling day-to-day operational requests from the business. 

Project management, ability to successfully manage multiple tasks at any given point, strong relationship building skills & communication skills. 

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills including the ability to build consensus and to present complex presentations. 

Ability to communicate effectively, to recognize, understand, and manage one’s own emotions as well as others, and foster positive working relationships across all levels of the organization. 

Holding oneself responsible and being self-driven in accomplishing business goals, adhering to policies and being responsible for one’s own actions, performance, and decisions. 

Proficiency using Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and/or Access). 

Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).  

Preferred Knowledge, Skills, Abilities or Certifications:

Certification in Business Analysis (ECBA). 

Certification as a Salesforce Administrator.

Travel Requirements:

No travel required.

Overtime/Additional Hours Requirements:

Additional Hours May Be Required (Exempt Positions)

Physical Requirements

Normal Office Environment

Indoor work in a climate-controlled environment.

Sedentary work. Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a Critical Infrastructure Security Analyst to work in our Controls department within the Cybercore Integration Center (CIC). Our team works a 9x80 schedule located at INL’s Research and Education Campus (REC) in Idaho Falls, ID with every other Friday off. You will report to the Senior Manager of Controls.

You will develop and deliver cybersecurity training for Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to external audiences, both on-site and off-site, and serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) on ICS cybersecurity for the CIC. Using past experiences, education, skills, and subject matter expertise, you must be able to provide technical direction, foster new concept development, and provide technical interface with customers. You will recommend and implement advanced instructional methods, including in-person instructor led, virtual learning, and dynamic simulation-based environments. Finally, you will propose and develop training based on realistic ICS threat scenarios, data analysis, communications, and complex network management systems.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Provide technical instruction and expertise in ICS cybersecurity threat detection, prevention, and management.
Gather information and complete analysis of cyber threats to the United States and its critical infrastructure and technology-controlled processes. Perform as a cybersecurity and ICS subject matter expert.
Work on complex issues in cybersecurity, determine methods and procedures on assignments and coordinate activities of other personnel.
Interface with ICS and critical infrastructure protection community to meet program requirements. Interfaces with customers to meet project requirements.
Represent organization as prime contact on projects and work.
Represent the program as an instructor in on-site and off-site cybersecurity training activities.
Provide leadership and mentoring to assigned members of small agile teams within the department.
Create reports and provide briefings related to these issues.

Required

Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Control Systems, or closely related field and 5 years of relevant working experience, or an advanced degree in the same fields and 2 years of relevant working experience.
Level 4: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Control Systems, or closely related field and 9 years of relevant working experience, a Master’s degree in the same fields and 6 years of relevant working experience, or a PhD in the same fields and 4 years of relevant working experience.
Ability obtain and maintain a DOE Q-clearance with appropriate sigmas and SCI clearance with ability and willingness to complete polygraph and become a full-time member of the Field Intelligence Element, which requires U.S. Citizenship

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Possess an advanced degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.
Possess strong public speaking and presentation skills, with experience instructing technical subjects to professional audiences.
Demonstrate experience developing cybersecurity courses, labs, and curriculum, including hands-on or simulation-based exercises.
Serve as an instructor in on-site and off-site ICS cybersecurity training activities, providing technical instruction in ICS asset and threat identification, protection, attack detection, and response management.
Maintain knowledge of ICS and critical infrastructure security related events, threats, and developments, and apply that knowledge to course content and to the identification and development of new divisional capabilities and products.
Possess hands-on experience with Industrial Control Systems/SCADA/Process Control system design and experimentation, including control system protocols, process control software, data communications, network security, wireless instrumentation security, graphical user interfaces, experimental setup and testing, sensors, and modeling and simulation.
Demonstrate experience in Blue or Purple Team operations in either IT or OT environments.
Exhibit experience operating or maintaining a control systems laboratory, test bed, or cyber range environment.
Demonstrate creativity in developing new training approaches, methodologies, and demonstration capabilities.
Ability to assist management in defining strategic direction in assigned areas. Create and implement new methodologies and architectures that advance the mission of the CIC in the cyber and physical security arenas.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires the operation of office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Information

The pay range for this position is: Level 3 ($95,256 - $195,288 ) / Level 4 ($114,360 - $234,336). At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.
Multi-Level: This is a multi-level posting and you will be placed at the appropriate level dependent on depth and breadth of proven experience and skills.
TDP: This is a testing designated position; you will be required to submit to a pre-employment drug screen and periodic drug testing throughout the term of your employment.
This position requires up to 20% domestic travel to deliver off-site training.

About Us

jobs.description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently looking for a Staff Program Manager, Marketing Enablement
to join our Marketing team. This role is open to candidates in Vancouver, Calgary or Toronto.

What your team does:

Our global marketing team moves faster when the processes, data, and systems underneath it are built right. We're looking for a Staff Program Manager who treats marketing enablement as a comprehensive challenge: you design and build the AI-first processes that change how the team works day to day, not just the training that tells them how.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who wants to build, ship, and measure, not just run workshops. You're equally comfortable doing the user research to design a comprehensive solution, standing up a new AI-first process end to end, architecting a playbook system that scales, and proving with data that what you built actually moved the needle.

What you’ll work on:

Work Management Processes: Deeply understand our current tech stack, processes and challenges so you can design new, AI-first solutions. You’ll evaluate and pilot tools, build custom workflows, and integrations that put them directly into people's hands. You’ll set up the governance and access controls that keep usage safe, and instrument adoption so you know what's actually sticking.
Department-wide process ownership: You’ll develop a roadmap to address department-wide opportunities like AI transformation, new hire onboarding, acquisition integration, and more that have impact across the department. You’ll design systems with feedback loops so the program improves itself over time.
Skills Development Systems: Identify capability gaps across the team using data, then build the self-serve resources, certification tracking, and learning tools that close them at scale. Workshops are one input; the systems that make learning repeatable without you in the room are the real deliverable.
Playbook & Process Tooling: Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and lightweight internal tools that encode processes, reduce tribal knowledge, and let anyone on the team self-serve the right answer.
Effectiveness Instrumentation: Build the dashboards and tracking that measure the impact: adoption rates, time-to-productivity, engagement, and qualitative signal. Report to the Director and use the data to decide what gets built next and what gets killed.

Who you’ll collaborate with:

With the Director, Marketing Strategy & Enablement:
Align the build roadmap with strategic priorities, define success metrics together, and make sure what you ship is sequenced and resourced to deliver real impact.

With IT and Legal:
Partner closely to evaluate, procure, and safely deploy AI and productivity tools, with data privacy, security, and responsible-use requirements built in before anything launches.

With Marketing Sub-Team Leaders
: Work with leaders across demand gen, content, brand, SEO, and marketing ops to understand their teams' capability gaps, co-design the tools and systems that solve them, and drive adoption within their functions.

What you bring:

8+ years in marketing, revenue, or GTM enablement, learning & development, marketing operations, or a closely related technical field, with a track record of building systems and tools, not just running programs.
Hands-on technical depth: You've built things. Comfort with APIs, prompt engineering, and automation tools (Zapier, Make, or similar) is table stakes. Reading and writing code (Python, JavaScript) lets you ship a workflow or integration yourself is a huge asset.
AI fluency that's hands-on: You've evaluated, piloted, and shipped generative AI tools into real workflows, and you have a point of view on where they create leverage for marketers versus where they're hype.
Martech and systems literacy: You understand how marketing's tool stack fits together (CRM, marketing automation, analytics, content and workflow tools) well enough to spot where a new tool or integration will break something downstream.
Program management with a builder's bias: You design and run multiple initiatives with a high degree of autonomy, but your instinct is to build the system that solves the problem permanently rather than the one-time fix.
Communication and influence: You can explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder and a program outcome to an engineer. You earn trust quickly with both individual contributors and senior leaders.

This is a new role.

What you will find here:

Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance
Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.
Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.
$2000 annual counseling benefit
RRSP matching and RESP contribution
Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

The expected salary range for this role is $134,900 to $202,300 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
Title:
Project Manager

Location:
Oak Brook, IL (Chicago Metro Area), 5 days per week in-person

Reports to:
PMO Manager

Position Overview

Worldpac is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Project Management Office (PMO) and lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional enterprise projects, with a strong focus on accelerating Worldpac's enterprise AI program across our high-volume wholesale distribution and automotive aftermarket business. This role will manage the end-to-end planning and execution of AI and technology initiatives, from initiation through deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Working closely with the Director AI Product Management, AI Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders, the Project Manager ensures AI initiatives are appropriately scoped, resourced, governed, and delivered on time, on budget, and to the expected business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a seasoned project leader who combines strong project management discipline with hands-on experience implementing enterprise AI solutions, and who can lead teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, complex enterprise AI and technology projects, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, and closure.
Develop and maintain project charters, scope statements, integrated project plans, schedules, resource plans, and budgets aligned with PMO standards and governance.
Manage project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and dependencies, using change control to manage scope changes and trade-offs.
Apply Agile, hybrid, and waterfall delivery approaches as appropriate, facilitating sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives for AI delivery teams.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including AI engineers, data engineers, architects, developers, infrastructure, security, QA, vendors, and business subject matter experts.

Enterprise AI Project Execution

Partner with the Director AI Product Management, who owns AI product strategy, priorities, and success criteria, to translate approved AI initiatives into executable project plans.
Plan and manage the delivery of AI solutions such as generative AI assistants, agentic AI workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, AI-enabled process automation, AI enterprise tools, and AI capabilities embedded in enterprise platforms.
Coordinate delivery activities, including data readiness, model and platform selection, prompt and agent development, AI gateway and integration work, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls, and user acceptance testing.
Manage pilot and proof-of-concept efforts through to production, including scaling, hypercare, and transition to support.
Ensure AI projects follow Worldpac's AI governance requirements, working with the AI Governance Committee, Architecture Review Board (ARB), Cybersecurity, Legal & Compliance, and Data Governance to obtain required reviews and approvals.

Risk, Issue & Change Management

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, including AI-specific risks such as data quality, accuracy, security, privacy, and responsible AI considerations.
Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and escalate cross-functional barriers through established PMO escalation paths.
Partner with business leaders, training, and change management resources to drive user readiness, communication, and adoption of AI solutions.

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

Serve as the primary point of contact for project status, providing clear, concise reporting to stakeholders, steering committees, the PMO Manager, and IT leadership.
Prepare and present project status, risks, financials, and decisions to executive audiences using PMO dashboards and reporting tools.
Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and decision-making forums, documenting decisions and action items to ensure accountability.

Financial & Vendor Management

Track project budgets, forecasts, and actuals, including AI platform, model usage, and implementation partner costs, in partnership with the PMO and Finance.
Manage implementation partners and vendors against SOWs, ensuring accountability for scope, quality, timelines, and deliverables.

PMO Practice & Leadership

Apply and help continuously improve PMO standards, methodologies, templates, and tools, including practices tailored to AI project delivery.
Capture lessons learned and best practices from AI projects to build repeatable delivery playbooks.
Mentor Associate Project Managers and project team members, providing guidance on project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills

10+ years of progressive project management experience delivering complex IT and enterprise technology projects, including leading cross-functional teams and implementation partners.
Demonstrated experience managing the implementation of enterprise AI projects, such as generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, AI-enabled process automation, or advanced analytics solutions, from pilot through production.
Experience with projects leveraging enterprise AI end user tools including Claude, Copilot, etc.
Experience with enterprise AI platforms and services such as AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, other agentic platforms and repositories, and AI gateways such as Kong.
Experience delivering AI and technology projects that integrate with enterprise systems, for example Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, IBM i (iSeries), and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Working understanding of AI concepts and the AI solution lifecycle, including large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, model evaluation, and AI risk considerations.
Proven track record managing large-scale projects from initiation to completion on time, on budget, and to scope.
Strong experience with Agile / Scrum, hybrid, and waterfall methodologies.
Strong expertise in Jira and Confluence project management tools required, preferred experience in Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or other similar tools.
Experience managing project budgets, vendor SOWs, and implementation partners.
Strong risk, issue, and change management skills, including organizational change and user adoption.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with strong presentation skills and the ability to convey complex technical topics clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to influence and drive results without direct authority in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a high level of attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the automotive aftermarket or other high-volume wholesale distribution, supply chain, or logistics environments.
Experience delivering AI capabilities embedded in enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle Fusion, Workday).
Familiarity with AI governance and Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF).
Experience working within a PMO in a geographically dispersed, multi-site environment.
Experience operating within a parent-company or portfolio-company governance structure.

Education / Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification required.
Agile certification (e.g., PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe) preferred; AI-related certifications (e.g., Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, PMI-CPMAI) are a plus.

Posted Salary Range

USD $120,000.00 - USD $140,000.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

Who we are looking for

As a customer-facing Deployment Strategist (internally we call these Delivery Engineers), you are a relationship builder and technical guide who is passionate about growing strategic accounts by transforming AI solutions into lasting customer partnerships. Due to the deep technical nature of the environment we work in, you are someone who can understand advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries and excel at working directly with customers to understand their challenges, ambitions, and evolving needs while serving as their primary point of contact.

We welcome diverse technical backgrounds that bring valuable perspectives to our product. You may come from a Data Science/Machine Learning background with deep understanding of the end-to-end AI/ML product lifecycle, enabling you to explain complex technical concepts to stakeholders and identify new areas of application. Alternatively, you may have an engineering profile bringing domain-specific engineering understanding that helps connect our solutions to real industry challenges. In either case, you bring a unique perspective and you help customers bridge the gap between advanced AI capabilities and practical engineering applications. Note that your current role might not leverage your technical background - for example you might have left the field of engineering but are interesting in returning! You are a keen learner who will become up-to-speed with our core technology stack, cloud/software deployment, and product features, allowing you to support customers with guiding activities and technical requests.

With 4+ years industry experience in a commercial, customer-facing environment, you're ready to take ownership of the complete customer journey, from onboarding and change management to roadmap planning and contract preparation. You excel at strategic planning, time management, and problem-solving, with natural organizational skills that enable you to manage sprint planning, deliverables alignment, and smooth project delivery. Experience in industrial or advanced manufacturing sectors—such as automotive, semiconductors, or materials—is preferred.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll work closely with both customers and our Simulation Engineers, Software Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are build solutions for. You will:

Build and maintain relationships with users and senior decision-makers at our customers
Run the account operating rhythm: executive reviews, account reporting, and tracking of delivery progress and value
Own the customer onboarding journey and drive change management, making sure what we build gets adopted and creates measurable value
Track adoption and engagement, working side-by-side with customers to collect signal and feedback
Support the running of customer delivery teams, including onboarding of embedded team members, team health surveys, and customer satisfaction (NPS)
Build AI-enabled tooling to make account operations faster and more scalable
Support new business development on the account and in adjacent semiconductor opportunities, including identifying problems and stakeholders, preparing proposals, and supporting contracting
Translate customer industry challenges into product feedback for the product team

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!
https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world

What We Offer

Equity options – share in our success and growth.
5% 401(k) contribution – invest in your future.
Flexible working – balance your work and life in a way that works for you.
Hybrid setup – enjoy our Manhattan office while keeping remote flexibility.
Enhanced parental leave – support for life’s biggest milestones.
Private healthcare – comprehensive coverage for you and your family.
Personal development – access learning and training to help you grow.
Work from anywhere – extend your remote setup to enjoy the sun or reconnect with loved ones.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we're building a culture where everyone belongs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, welcoming talent of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Changing the face of tech takes action, which is why we actively encourage individuals from historically underrepresented groups to apply.

Salary Range

$90,000 - 130,000 depending on experience

Seniority will be assessed throughout our interview process.

Agile Defense is seeking qualified professionals to support national security intelligence and operational analysis missions within a multi-agency federal environment. This work supports critical government efforts focused on identity resolution, threat screening, intelligence analysis, and information sharing across the U.S. national security and law enforcement community. The mission operates in a fast-paced operational environment supporting national security priorities, with teams working collaboratively across government partners to ensure timely analysis, data integrity, and operational coordination. Support may include intelligence analysis, operational support, program management, and mission coordination activities that contribute to protecting the United States from national security threats.

Have working knowledge of threat and vulnerability analysis, routing protocols, routing, intrusion detection systems, intrusion protection systems, Domain Name Service, or network traffic analysis
