jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $187,000 – $207,000, which may vary by geographic location. Compensation also includes a competitive equity grant, an annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Your final offer will reflect your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position involves access to export-controlled information. To comply with U.S. government export regulations, applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:
U.S. citizen or national
U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157
Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158
Be eligible to access export-controlled information without requiring an export authorization.
Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Aalyria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

187,000 - 207,000 USD per year (Remote (DC, US))

jobs.title: ABA Sr. Program Manager / Mid-Tier Supervisor
jobs.description:
Join the largest female clinician-led ABA agency in the country and work with people who just get it. At Autism Learning Partners, we’re all about growing together, learning from each other, and actually making a difference! Whether you're fresh in the field or leveling up, you'll find mentorship, career growth, and a whole community of BCBAs ready to cheer you on!

Career path to $90,000+ base salary via the BCBA certification pathway!

What We’re Looking For

Master’s degree in Psychology, Child Development, Special Education, Applied Behavioral Analysis, or related program, required
Enrolled in a BCBA program and/or obtaining hours towards certification, preferred
At least one year of experience providing clinical program management (under the supervision of a BCBA)
Please note that this position is subject to fingerprinting, TB test, Pre-employment Physical Exam, and have or receive immunities to MMR/ VZV during our onboarding, which we will pay for

We’re dedicated to the science of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA). We believe in the power of our science to transform the lives of children and their families touched by Autism and related disorders through the oversight of clinical supervisors such as a BCBA and Senior Program Manager. As a passionate team of clinicians (BCBA) and clinical supervisors, we are committed to delivering best practices, providing hope, support and progress through both home and clinic-based services. We provide unparalleled levels of personal care, proven ABA science, world-class business support, and professionalism.

The Basics Of This Opportunity

Base Compensation: $32.00 – $36 per hour (based on experience, skills, and geography)
Bonus: Attainable monthly/quarterly bonus opportunities (earn $35,000+ in your first three years)
Monthly Billable Expectation: 120–130 hours
Growth: Full support and clear opportunities to advance into BCBA, Sr. BCBA, and Director roles
Some Benefits Highlights: Opportunity for direct & indirect supervision hours, study support and training to help you pass the BCBA exam, 13 days off annually between holidays including 1 floating holiday and PTO, that begins to accrue from Day 1
Initial Onboarding Support: 60+ hours of comprehensive training during the first 3-4 weeks of integration including topics such as clinical best practices, using Central Reach, goal writing, clinical problem solving, CPT codes, telehealth assessments. Our Clinical Development team also offers weekly office hours or 1:1 support, as needed.
Education and Mentorship: Monthly CEUs and an annual in-house conference featuring leading researchers in the field
Flexible Schedule: Mon-Fri flexibility in the mornings, mid-day, and afternoons up until 6:30pm most nights, with two to three evenings per week of availability until 8:30pm (we pay extra for evenings!). No expectation of Saturday work unless you want to schedule make-up sessions. You’re in full control!
Our Promise: We don't require contracts or non-compete agreements because we value flexibility and trust. Your employment with us is fully at-will, allowing you to grow with us on your own terms.

Why Choose Us?

An org chart of nothing but BCBAs between you and the CEO, Dr. Gina Chang, BCBA-D.
A clear path to make values-based clinical decisions based entirely on what is best for your client and family
Generous health insurance package, 401(k) Retirement Program with employer match, and employer paid short-term disability
As a CASP Provider, ALP will grant you access to CASP’s entire CEU library which includes over 75 CEU-approved courses (plus 10 CEUs annually via ALP events such as our IMPACT Conference and monthly live sessions)
Clear promotion framework from BCBA, Sr. BCBA, Assistant Clinical Director, Clinical Director, and Senior Clinical Director
For any new BCBA certificants – we offer the 8-hour supervision course as approved by the BACB
Unlimited referral bonuses
Reasonable expectation of billable hours and manageable caseloads
Opportunity to partner and/or serve with our internal DEI council
Study support for BCBA candidates and in-house RBT courses to help ensure your team is fully prepared
Support Center resources designed to address your administrative needs, including client intake, recruiting, payroll, HR, billing, credentialing/contracting, and scheduling

What You’ll Be Doing

Inspire Growth and Progress: Supervise and evaluate client programs, provide parent education, conduct assessments, and solve problems to ensure continuous client progress under the guidance of a BCBA.
Empower and Support: Motivate and mentor behavior technicians, coordinate client visits, and offer coaching and clinical support to enhance service quality.
Champion Accountability: Ensure clients receive full clinical prescriptions, maintain accurate records of billable hours, and deliver timely progress reports and treatment plans.
Adapt and Thrive: Balance direct intervention with supervisory responsibilities, embrace new challenges, prioritize tasks effectively, and remain flexible to manage a dynamic caseload.
Motivate and Elevate: Support staff productivity, assist in performance evaluations, and provide crucial support to parents and technicians during urgent situations.
Meets ALP’s standards and funding source required best practices related to client facing care and parent consultation

Autism Learning Partners supports a diverse workforce and is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

At Autism Learning Partners, we understand that culture is the foundation of who we are as a company and how we serve our clients, families, and employees. We are one of the nation's leading full-service ABA providers specializing in the treatment of autism and other developmental disabilities. Our broad thinking approach addresses the whole child by collaborating with doctors, therapists, families, schools, and specialists. Our goal is to work together to achieve the best possible outcome and progress through our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, and Equity, which includes forming a DEI council, monthly trainings for senior clinical staff, national trainings, a monthly DEI newsletter, continual updates to our email signatures, education on topics like generational trauma and trauma-informed care, and always striving to provide the best care and comfort for our clients, families, and employees.

As the operator of a federally funded research and development center (FFRDC), we are broadly engaged across all aspects of space— delivering innovative solutions that span satellite, launch, ground, and cyber systems for defense, civil and commercial customers. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a special collection of problem solvers, thought leaders, and innovators. Join us and take your place in space.

The Infrastructure and Facilities Assurance Department (IFAD) is the source of expertise in Operations and Facilities Engineering to our corporate customers. IFAD provides an array of technical capabilities that support our customers in assuring the availability, readiness and success of ground assets/services required to meet the needs of the space enterprise.

We have a current need for motivated architects/project managers to join our high-performing team in solving some of today’s hardest problems and help evolve our capabilities in meeting the technical challenges of tomorrow. This position requires an innovative but decisive individual who works effectively in a highly collaborative, team-based environment that can set goals/expectations and effectively execute. We are seeking experienced candidates with the ability to lead multi-disciplinary project teams proficient in all phases of project design and controls, including architectural programming, requirements/concept design development, construction, operations & maintenance/sustainment.

Job Title: Assistant Project Manager Environmental Construction

Job Description

The Assistant Project Manager Environmental Construction oversees field operations for environmental and heavy civil projects, coordinating subcontractors and site personnel to ensure safety, quality, and schedule compliance. This role requires extensive time in the field, strong leadership of multidisciplinary construction teams, and a focus on successful project delivery from planning through completion. The position supports project managers with scheduling, budgeting, and forecasting while maintaining thorough documentation and communication with stakeholders and regulatory agencies.

Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day field operations for environmental and heavy civil construction projects, maintaining a strong presence at project sites.
Direct and coordinate subcontractors, vendors, and site personnel to ensure efficient, safe, and high-quality execution of work.
Monitor construction progress to confirm that project milestones and schedules are achieved and adjust activities as needed to stay on track.
Conduct regular production, scheduling, and coordination meetings to align all trades and stakeholders on project status and upcoming work.
Ensure full compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality requirements across all field activities.
Review construction activities for adherence to project specifications, permits, and applicable regulations, addressing any discrepancies promptly.
Coordinate with owners, engineers, inspectors, and regulatory agencies throughout project execution to maintain clear communication and alignment.
Identify and resolve field issues quickly, proposing practical solutions to maintain project momentum and minimize downtime.
Prepare and maintain accurate daily reports, field documentation, RFIs, change orders, and progress updates.
Promote and maintain a safe, organized, and productive job site environment for all team members and subcontractors.
Support project managers with project scheduling, budgeting, and forecasting, including data analysis and project monitoring.
Lead and supervise field construction crews and subcontractors, providing guidance, direction, and performance oversight.
Manage project schedules and coordinate multiple trades to optimize productivity and minimize conflicts in the field.
Participate in subcontractor meetings and coordination sessions to review performance, upcoming work, and resource needs.
Oversee ordering of materials and equipment required for field activities and ensure timely delivery to project sites.
Use data analysis and project monitoring tools to track performance metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
Contribute to the development and implementation of construction safety programs and industry best practices at the job site.

Essential Skills

Significant experience supervising field construction crews and subcontractors in environmental, heavy civil, mechanical, or industrial construction settings.
Strong knowledge of construction safety programs and industry best practices, with the ability to enforce safety standards in the field.
Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents to guide field execution.
Experience managing project schedules and coordinating multiple trades to meet milestones and deadlines.
Demonstrated strength in problem-solving and leadership, with the ability to make sound decisions under field conditions.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office and construction documentation software for reporting, scheduling, and data analysis.
Ability to conduct and lead production, scheduling, and coordination meetings with internal teams and subcontractors.
Experience in subcontractor management, including directing daily activities, holding subcontractor meetings, and monitoring performance.
Competence in project monitoring, data analysis, and scheduling to support project managers with forecasting and budgeting.
Valid drivers license and ability to travel regularly to project sites as required by project assignments.
Experience with landfill gas collection and control systems (GCCS).
Experience with projects involving renewable natural gas (RNG), biogas, methane capture, environmental remediation, utility, or energy.
Experience in heavy civil, environmental, mechanical, or industrial construction, with hands-on field management responsibilities.
OSHA certifications and experience managing complex field operations with a strong focus on safety and compliance.

Additional Skills & Qualifications

Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Science, or a related field preferred but not required.
Experience coordinating with owners, engineers, inspectors, and regulatory agencies throughout project execution.
Ability to review construction activities for compliance with project specifications, permits, and applicable regulations.
Experience preparing and maintaining daily reports, RFIs, change orders, and other field documentation.
Skill in promoting a safe, organized, and productive job site environment.
Interest in growing into a leadership role overseeing other field environmental technicians.
Comfort working within multidisciplinary construction teams on environmental and energy-related projects.

This role is primarily field-focused, with work based out of the nearest office and regular travel between project sites from the Bakersfield/Santa Maria area to Sacramento. The Assistant Project Manager spends significant time on active construction sites, overseeing environmental and heavy civil work, interacting with subcontractors, engineers, inspectors, and regulatory agencies. The company is 100% employee-owned and offers an excellent employee stock ownership program upon permanent hire, along with benefits that may include medical coverage, retirement savings options, paid time off, and holidays during contract periods. Title: Senior Program Manager

Location: South San Francisco

Type: Full-time / On-Site

Ohalo is hiring a Senior Program Manager (PM) to lead strategic programs across the organization. You will run cross-functional programs that span Biotech R&D, engineering, and operations. You will take complex initiatives from concept to delivery.

This is a full-accountability leadership role. You will act as general manager for a set of high-impact programs. You will own outcomes, set strategy, and direct work across technical and business teams.

This role requires strong program management fundamentals and a track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives. You should be a strong leader and systems thinker who is motivated to build AI apps and agents that keep work running continuously.

The ideal person thrives in a high-ownership, fast-moving environment and is excited by leading complex, high-stakes initiatives from ambiguity to execution. AI is changing how biological discovery and development get done. We want someone who will lead that change, not wait for it.

Responsibilities:

Program General Management & Accountability

Own program success for one or more strategic, cross-functional programs.
Design and implement scalable processes and methods for planning, execution, and tracking.
Drive alignment with stakeholders and executive leadership. own decisions, escalations, and accountability.
Own budgeting, forecasting, and analytics of managed programs.

Cross-Functional Execution & Communication

Build and maintain integrated program plans that connect workstreams across teams. Make dependencies and critical paths explicit, and manage them.
Define how each program fits together: workstreams, interfaces, handoffs, and validation. Keep teams executing to one integrated schedule.
Make the call on trade-offs and escalations; drive alignment across scientists, operators, and executive leadership without waiting for consensus.
Spot bottlenecks early and unblock teams through clear priorities and fast follow-through.
Translate technical complexity into clear artifacts for audiences ranging from scientists to Ohalo's board.
Use AI as a force multiplier that runs program work, continuously (tracking, reporting, follow-ups), not one-off analyses or reports. Hold a high bar for accuracy and traceability.

The Impact You Will Have

Reporting to the VP, Project Manager, the AVP, Project Manager is responsible for managing the acquisition of limited partnership interests in affordable housing developments. As a member of an acquisitions pod, this role manages assigned LIHTC transactions from underwriting and due diligence through closing, ensuring thorough financial analysis, effective risk mitigation, and timely execution. The AVP works closely with developers, investors, and internal stakeholders to advance transactions, coordinate deliverables, and develop sound investment recommendations. As part of a growing business within Walker & Dunlop, this position offers the opportunity to take ownership of complex transactions, strengthen technical expertise, and contribute to the continued growth and success of the platform.

Serving as a primary point of contact for sustainment-related program issues and customer interactions, this individual will coordinate closely with General Atomics Japan K.K., Indo-Pacific customers, and internal GA stakeholders. The position will support the preparation of sustainment concepts, proposals, business plans, work statements, and operating budgets related to logistics and maintenance. The individual will apply Lean Six Sigma and aviation maintenance expertise to improve readiness, reduce downtime, and enhance operational availability.

This position requires strong leadership, aviation maintenance and logistics experience, and the ability to operate effectively in joint, allied, and international environments across the Indo-Pacific.

Design and implement supply, logistics, and maintenance solutions that optimize aircraft readiness, fleet availability, and lifecycle cost.

Provide expert input to risk analyses and contingency plans addressing logistics, maintenance, and supply chain risks in forward-deployed and austere environments.

Lead and manage defense munition programs ensuring alignment with customer requirements and business objectives.

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

Minimum of 7 years of experience in program management within aerospace defense or related sectors.
Strong knowledge of defense munition program requirements, compliance, and regulatory standards.
Proven ability to develop and manage complex program plans including scheduling, budgeting, and resource allocation.
Experience with risk management and mitigation strategies specific to aerospace defense projects.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field.

Strong leadership and decision-making skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities tailored to complex defense projects.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain pragmatic when requirements or priorities change

(NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Lead and manage defense munition programs ensuring alignment with customer requirements and business objectives.
Develop and implement program plans including scope, schedule, budget, and resource allocation.

Monitor program performance metrics and ensure compliance with defense industry standards and regulations.
Provide leadership and guidance to program teams fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field.

Strong leadership and decision-making skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities tailored to complex defense projects.

7 years of experience or knowledge of the Aerospace industry specifically in navigation

Strong communication (oral and written) and executive presentation skills

Responsable de processus d'affaires

organization and reports to the Quote to Order Process Manager
.

This is a high-impact, cross-functional role at the heart of our commercial transformation.

What You Will Do

Lead implementation of the global Quote-to-Order process across your region.
Facilitate workshops to map current country processes against the global target, identify gaps, and define how they are resolved.
Support countries through a complete tool landscape transformation — you'll be equally comfortable helping teams understand new processes and navigating new tools.

Coordinate deployment of CPQ and related solutions, including the commercial process integration and handover into SAP S/4HANA.

Define and execute country implementation plans covering preparation, testing, training, go-live and stabilization. Coordinate user acceptance testing and implementation readiness with countries and IT/IS teams.
Champion continuous improvement post go-live, translating recurring business challenges into structured requirements for process and tool enhancements.

What You Bring

3-5 years of proven experience in commercial process implementation, digital transformation or business change roles in a B2B environment.

Experience working with commercial platforms such as CPQ, CRM, CLM or ERP is an advantage.

You do not need to be a Process Owner, CPQ specialist or ERP expert, but you must have enough breadth across commercial, process and systems topics to lead implementation to successful adoption.

new_jobs.title: Business Analyst Leader
new_jobs.description:
VinFast là một thương hiệu Việt Nam, cam kết theo đuổi tầm nhìn trở thành thương hiệu xe điện thông minh toàn cầu. VinFast đã đặt nền móng cho ngành công nghiệp ô tô điện và xe máy điện tại Việt Nam, đồng thời tích cực thúc đẩy cuộc cách mạng xe điện trên toàn thế giới.

Với triết lý lấy khách hàng làm trung tâm, VinFast không ngừng đổi mới và hội tụ các giá trị trí tuệ để tạo ra những sản phẩm đẳng cấp hàng đầu, giá cả phải chăng cùng dịch vụ hậu mãi vượt trội. Bên cạnh đó, VinFast mang đến cho mọi người cơ hội tiếp cận xe điện thông minh, đồng thời góp phần xây dựng một tương lai xanh, thông minh và bền vững.

Chúng tôi đang tìm kiếm
Trưởng phòng Nghiệp vụ sản phẩm
chịu trách nhiệm dẫn dắt toàn bộ hoạt động phân tích nghiệp vụ cho các nhóm sản phẩm/ứng dụng AI trên xe: Trợ lý ảo trên ô tô điện VinFast và các sản phẩm AI liên quan dữ liệu. Vai trò này chuyển định hướng sản phẩm và nhu cầu người dùng thành hệ thống tài liệu yêu cầu rõ ràng, khả thi và đo lường được (PRD, Use Case, User Story, đặc tả dữ liệu/AI, tiêu chí nghiệm thu); đồng thời là đầu mối phối hợp với đội kỹ thuật (AI/LLM, Data Platform, Android Automotive, Backend), UX/UI và các đối tác trong - ngoài Tập đoàn. Bên cạnh công việc chuyên môn, vị trí chịu trách nhiệm xây dựng chuẩn nghiệp vụ, quy trình làm việc và năng lực cho đội ngũ BA của Phòng.

A. Nghiệp vụ sản phẩm Trợ lý ảo

1. Dẫn dắt đội ngũ BA thu thập, phân tích và quản lý yêu cầu cho sản phẩm - AI Voice Assistant trên ô tô điện VinFast, bao phủ các nhóm tính năng: điều khiển xe, dẫn đường, giải trí, tìm kiếm thông tin và trợ giúp cá nhân.

2. Chuyển định hướng sản phẩm thành PRD, Use Case, User Story, luồng hội thoại (conversation flow), luồng nghiệp vụ (workflow) và tiêu chí nghiệm thu cụ thể cho từng phiên bản phát hành.

3. Đặc tả yêu cầu cho các thành phần AI của trợ lý ảo: nhận diện ý định (NLU/intent), gọi công cụ (tool/function calling), kịch bản agent, quy tắc an toàn nội dung (guardrail) và cơ chế xử lý khi hệ thống hiểu sai.

4. Đảm bảo mọi yêu cầu gắn với trải nghiệm trong xe: an toàn khi lái, độ trễ phản hồi, tính tự nhiên của hội thoại và khả năng hoạt động khi mất kết nối.

5. Phối hợp chặt chẽ với đội kỹ thuật (AI/Dev Engineer) và UX/UI để bảo đảm giải pháp khả thi về kỹ thuật và đúng chuẩn trải nghiệm HMI.

B. Nghiệp vụ AI cho bài toán dữ liệu

1. Xác định và đặc tả các bài toán AI/dữ liệu: cá nhân hóa gợi ý, dự báo nhu cầu, phát hiện bất thường trong vận hành xe và dịch vụ,…

2. Xây dựng yêu cầu nghiệp vụ cho toàn vòng đời dữ liệu: nguồn dữ liệu, kế hoạch thu thập sự kiện (event/tracking plan), tiêu chuẩn chất lượng dữ liệu và yêu cầu tuân thủ bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.

3. Làm việc với Data Engineer/Data Scientist để chuyển bài toán kinh doanh thành bài toán cụ thể: định nghĩa đầu vào/đầu ra, tiêu chí đánh giá (độ chính xác, precision/recall, độ trễ), phương án thử nghiệm A/B và điều kiện đưa vào vận hành.

4. Thiết kế và quản trị hệ thống báo cáo, dashboard đo lường sản phẩm (mức độ sử dụng, tỷ lệ quay lại, tỷ lệ thành công theo tính năng).

5. Đảm bảo dữ liệu thu thập và sử dụng đúng quy định pháp luật và chính sách riêng tư của Tập đoàn tại các thị trường triển khai.

C. Quản lý và phát triển đội ngũ

1. Quản lý, phân công và phát triển đội ngũ BA; xây dựng lộ trình năng lực, đào tạo và đánh giá hiệu quả công việc.

2. Chuẩn hóa quy trình phân tích nghiệp vụ, hệ thống tài liệu và công cụ quản trị yêu cầu; bảo đảm chất lượng đầu ra đồng nhất giữa các nhóm sản phẩm.

Requirements

Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các ngành: Hệ thống thông tin, CNTT, Khoa học dữ liệu, Toán - Thống kê, Kinh tế hoặc liên quan.

Tối thiểu 5 năm kinh nghiệm phân tích nghiệp vụ/quản lý sản phẩm, trong đó có ít nhất 2 năm ở vai trò quản lý đội nhóm (Trưởng nhóm/Team Lead trở lên).

Có kinh nghiệm trực tiếp với ít nhất một trong hai mảng:

o Sản phẩm hội thoại – Chatbot/Voicebot/Voice Assistant.

o Sản phẩm dữ liệu – phân tích dữ liệu, BI, Machine Learning.

Thành thạo viết PRD, Use Case, User Story, Workflow, Wireframe và tiêu chí nghiệm thu.

Có năng lực làm việc trực tiếp với dữ liệu: đọc hiểu mô hình dữ liệu, viết được truy vấn SQL, sử dụng công cụ BI (Power BI/Tableau hoặc tương đương).

Hiểu biết về AI/LLM và vòng đời phát triển mô hình: dữ liệu huấn luyện, đánh giá chất lượng, giám sát sau triển khai.

Thành thạo các công cụ: Jira, Confluence, Figma, Miro, BPMN/UML.

Kỹ năng phân tích, tổng hợp, trình bày và thuyết phục; kỹ năng lãnh đạo đội nhóm và điều phối đa phòng ban.

Ưu tiên:

Kinh nghiệm với Generative AI, NLP, LLM, RAG hoặc hệ thống Agent.

Kinh nghiệm trong lĩnh vực Automotive, Android Automotive OS, IoT hoặc hệ thống nhúng.

Hiểu biết về quy định bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân (Nghị định 13/2023/NĐ-CP, GDPR/PDPA).

Có tư duy sản phẩm (product mindset), hiểu rõ vòng đời phát triển sản phẩm công nghệ.

Kinh nghiệm triển khai sản phẩm cho thị trường quốc tế (Ấn Độ, Indonesia…).

Khả năng giao tiếp tốt bằng tiếng Anh.

Benefits

Mức lương cạnh tranh

Gói chăm sóc sức khỏe cao cấp, bao gồm bảo hiểm PVI và khám sức khỏe định kỳ hằng năm

Lương tháng 13 và thưởng theo hiệu suất làm việc nhằm ghi nhận đóng góp của bạn

Hưởng ưu đãi khi sử dụng các dịch vụ trong hệ sinh thái Vingroup như Vinmec, Vinpearl, Vinschool…

Cơ hội hợp tác và học hỏi từ các chuyên gia hàng đầu trong lĩnh vực ô tô/robotics

Stakeholder & Project Management

Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and technical/AI teams

AI Transformation & Adoptionn

AI Solution & Product Support

Define requirements for Copilot, chatbot, RAG, AI Agent, and intelligent workflow solutions.
Work with AI engineers on knowledge sources, RAG scenarios, agent workflows, human-in-the-loop, output validation, and system integration.

Your Skills And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Business, Engineering, or related field.

Job Description

Idaho National Laboratory is hiring a Critical Infrastructure Security Analyst to work in our Controls department within the Cybercore Integration Center (CIC). Our team works a 9x80 schedule located at INL’s Research and Education Campus (REC) in Idaho Falls, ID with every other Friday off. You will report to the Senior Manager of Controls.

You will develop and deliver cybersecurity training for Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to external audiences, both on-site and off-site, and serve as a technical subject matter expert (SME) on ICS cybersecurity for the CIC. Using past experiences, education, skills, and subject matter expertise, you must be able to provide technical direction, foster new concept development, and provide technical interface with customers. You will recommend and implement advanced instructional methods, including in-person instructor led, virtual learning, and dynamic simulation-based environments. Finally, you will propose and develop training based on realistic ICS threat scenarios, data analysis, communications, and complex network management systems.

Essential Job Functions And Responsibilities

Provide technical instruction and expertise in ICS cybersecurity threat detection, prevention, and management.
Gather information and complete analysis of cyber threats to the United States and its critical infrastructure and technology-controlled processes. Perform as a cybersecurity and ICS subject matter expert.
Work on complex issues in cybersecurity, determine methods and procedures on assignments and coordinate activities of other personnel.
Interface with ICS and critical infrastructure protection community to meet program requirements. Interfaces with customers to meet project requirements.
Represent organization as prime contact on projects and work.
Represent the program as an instructor in on-site and off-site cybersecurity training activities.
Provide leadership and mentoring to assigned members of small agile teams within the department.
Create reports and provide briefings related to these issues.

Required

Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Control Systems, or closely related field and 5 years of relevant working experience, or an advanced degree in the same fields and 2 years of relevant working experience.
Level 4: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Control Systems, or closely related field and 9 years of relevant working experience, a Master’s degree in the same fields and 6 years of relevant working experience, or a PhD in the same fields and 4 years of relevant working experience.
Ability obtain and maintain a DOE Q-clearance with appropriate sigmas and SCI clearance with ability and willingness to complete polygraph and become a full-time member of the Field Intelligence Element, which requires U.S. Citizenship

The Ideal Candidate Will Possess

Possess an advanced degree in Engineering from an ABET accredited institution.
Possess strong public speaking and presentation skills, with experience instructing technical subjects to professional audiences.
Demonstrate experience developing cybersecurity courses, labs, and curriculum, including hands-on or simulation-based exercises.
Serve as an instructor in on-site and off-site ICS cybersecurity training activities, providing technical instruction in ICS asset and threat identification, protection, attack detection, and response management.
Maintain knowledge of ICS and critical infrastructure security related events, threats, and developments, and apply that knowledge to course content and to the identification and development of new divisional capabilities and products.
Possess hands-on experience with Industrial Control Systems/SCADA/Process Control system design and experimentation, including control system protocols, process control software, data communications, network security, wireless instrumentation security, graphical user interfaces, experimental setup and testing, sensors, and modeling and simulation.
Demonstrate experience in Blue or Purple Team operations in either IT or OT environments.
Exhibit experience operating or maintaining a control systems laboratory, test bed, or cyber range environment.
Demonstrate creativity in developing new training approaches, methodologies, and demonstration capabilities.
Ability to assist management in defining strategic direction in assigned areas. Create and implement new methodologies and architectures that advance the mission of the CIC in the cyber and physical security arenas.

Physical Requirements

While performing the duties of this classification, the employee is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, stoop, kneel, bend, and work in an office environment. The job requires hand/finger dexterity to keyboard or type, handle materials, manipulate tools, and reach with hands and arms. The job requires the operation of office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 35 pounds. Sufficient visual acuity and hearing capacity to perform the essential functions and interact with people is required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Job Information

The pay range for this position is: Level 3 ($95,256 - $195,288 ) / Level 4 ($114,360 - $234,336). At Idaho National Laboratory compensation decisions are determined using factors such as education, relevant experience, and other credentials.
Multi-Level: This is a multi-level posting and you will be placed at the appropriate level dependent on depth and breadth of proven experience and skills.
TDP: This is a testing designated position; you will be required to submit to a pre-employment drug screen and periodic drug testing throughout the term of your employment.
This position requires up to 20% domestic travel to deliver off-site training.

About Us

Medical, Dental, Vision, and Flexible Spending Accounts
401(k) with a 4.2% employer contribution and up to 4.8% match (regular positions) or self-contribute access (postdoctoral positions)

Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We are currently looking for a Staff Program Manager, Marketing Enablement
to join our Marketing team. This role is open to candidates in Vancouver, Calgary or Toronto.

What your team does:

Our global marketing team moves faster when the processes, data, and systems underneath it are built right. We're looking for a Staff Program Manager who treats marketing enablement as a comprehensive challenge: you design and build the AI-first processes that change how the team works day to day, not just the training that tells them how.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who wants to build, ship, and measure, not just run workshops. You're equally comfortable doing the user research to design a comprehensive solution, standing up a new AI-first process end to end, architecting a playbook system that scales, and proving with data that what you built actually moved the needle.

What you’ll work on:

Work Management Processes: Deeply understand our current tech stack, processes and challenges so you can design new, AI-first solutions. You’ll evaluate and pilot tools, build custom workflows, and integrations that put them directly into people's hands. You’ll set up the governance and access controls that keep usage safe, and instrument adoption so you know what's actually sticking.
Department-wide process ownership: You’ll develop a roadmap to address department-wide opportunities like AI transformation, new hire onboarding, acquisition integration, and more that have impact across the department. You’ll design systems with feedback loops so the program improves itself over time.
Skills Development Systems: Identify capability gaps across the team using data, then build the self-serve resources, certification tracking, and learning tools that close them at scale. Workshops are one input; the systems that make learning repeatable without you in the room are the real deliverable.
Playbook & Process Tooling: Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and lightweight internal tools that encode processes, reduce tribal knowledge, and let anyone on the team self-serve the right answer.
Effectiveness Instrumentation: Build the dashboards and tracking that measure the impact: adoption rates, time-to-productivity, engagement, and qualitative signal. Report to the Director and use the data to decide what gets built next and what gets killed.

Who you’ll collaborate with:

With the Director, Marketing Strategy & Enablement:
Align the build roadmap with strategic priorities, define success metrics together, and make sure what you ship is sequenced and resourced to deliver real impact.

With IT and Legal:
Partner closely to evaluate, procure, and safely deploy AI and productivity tools, with data privacy, security, and responsible-use requirements built in before anything launches.

With Marketing Sub-Team Leaders
: Work with leaders across demand gen, content, brand, SEO, and marketing ops to understand their teams' capability gaps, co-design the tools and systems that solve them, and drive adoption within their functions.

What you bring:

8+ years in marketing, revenue, or GTM enablement, learning & development, marketing operations, or a closely related technical field, with a track record of building systems and tools, not just running programs.
Hands-on technical depth: You've built things. Comfort with APIs, prompt engineering, and automation tools (Zapier, Make, or similar) is table stakes. Reading and writing code (Python, JavaScript) lets you ship a workflow or integration yourself is a huge asset.
AI fluency that's hands-on: You've evaluated, piloted, and shipped generative AI tools into real workflows, and you have a point of view on where they create leverage for marketers versus where they're hype.
Martech and systems literacy: You understand how marketing's tool stack fits together (CRM, marketing automation, analytics, content and workflow tools) well enough to spot where a new tool or integration will break something downstream.

Title:
Project Manager

Location:
Oak Brook, IL (Chicago Metro Area), 5 days per week in-person

Reports to:
PMO Manager

Position Overview

Worldpac is seeking an experienced Project Manager to join our Project Management Office (PMO) and lead the delivery of complex, cross-functional enterprise projects, with a strong focus on accelerating Worldpac's enterprise AI program across our high-volume wholesale distribution and automotive aftermarket business. This role will manage the end-to-end planning and execution of AI and technology initiatives, from initiation through deployment, adoption, and benefits realization.

Working closely with the Director AI Product Management, AI Engineering, Data, Infrastructure, Security, and business stakeholders, the Project Manager ensures AI initiatives are appropriately scoped, resourced, governed, and delivered on time, on budget, and to the expected business outcomes. The ideal candidate is a seasoned project leader who combines strong project management discipline with hands-on experience implementing enterprise AI solutions, and who can lead teams and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery

Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, complex enterprise AI and technology projects, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring and control, deployment, and closure.
Develop and maintain project charters, scope statements, integrated project plans, schedules, resource plans, and budgets aligned with PMO standards and governance.
Manage project scope, schedule, cost, quality, and dependencies, using change control to manage scope changes and trade-offs.
Apply Agile, hybrid, and waterfall delivery approaches as appropriate, facilitating sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives for AI delivery teams.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, including AI engineers, data engineers, architects, developers, infrastructure, security, QA, vendors, and business subject matter experts.

Enterprise AI Project Execution

Partner with the Director AI Product Management, who owns AI product strategy, priorities, and success criteria, to translate approved AI initiatives into executable project plans.
Plan and manage the delivery of AI solutions such as generative AI assistants, agentic AI workflows, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, AI-enabled process automation, AI enterprise tools, and AI capabilities embedded in enterprise platforms.
Coordinate delivery activities, including data readiness, model and platform selection, prompt and agent development, AI gateway and integration work, model evaluation, human-in-the-loop controls, and user acceptance testing.
Manage pilot and proof-of-concept efforts through to production, including scaling, hypercare, and transition to support.
Ensure AI projects follow Worldpac's AI governance requirements, working with the AI Governance Committee, Architecture Review Board (ARB), Cybersecurity, Legal & Compliance, and Data Governance to obtain required reviews and approvals.

Risk, Issue & Change Management

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate project risks and issues, including AI-specific risks such as data quality, accuracy, security, privacy, and responsible AI considerations.
Maintain RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and escalate cross-functional barriers through established PMO escalation paths.
Partner with business leaders, training, and change management resources to drive user readiness, communication, and adoption of AI solutions.

Stakeholder Management & Reporting

Serve as the primary point of contact for project status, providing clear, concise reporting to stakeholders, steering committees, the PMO Manager, and IT leadership.
Prepare and present project status, risks, financials, and decisions to executive audiences using PMO dashboards and reporting tools.
Facilitate project meetings, workshops, and decision-making forums, documenting decisions and action items to ensure accountability.

Financial & Vendor Management

Track project budgets, forecasts, and actuals, including AI platform, model usage, and implementation partner costs, in partnership with the PMO and Finance.
Manage implementation partners and vendors against SOWs, ensuring accountability for scope, quality, timelines, and deliverables.

PMO Practice & Leadership

Apply and help continuously improve PMO standards, methodologies, templates, and tools, including practices tailored to AI project delivery.
Capture lessons learned and best practices from AI projects to build repeatable delivery playbooks.
Mentor Associate Project Managers and project team members, providing guidance on project management practices.

Required Qualifications & Skills

10+ years of progressive project management experience delivering complex IT and enterprise technology projects, including leading cross-functional teams and implementation partners.
Demonstrated experience managing the implementation of enterprise AI projects, such as generative AI, agentic AI, machine learning, AI-enabled process automation, or advanced analytics solutions, from pilot through production.
Experience with projects leveraging enterprise AI end user tools including Claude, Copilot, etc.
Experience with enterprise AI platforms and services such as AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, other agentic platforms and repositories, and AI gateways such as Kong.
Experience delivering AI and technology projects that integrate with enterprise systems, for example Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, IBM i (iSeries), and enterprise data platforms such as Snowflake or Databricks.
Working understanding of AI concepts and the AI solution lifecycle, including large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents, model evaluation, and AI risk considerations.
Proven track record managing large-scale projects from initiation to completion on time, on budget, and to scope.
Strong experience with Agile / Scrum, hybrid, and waterfall methodologies.
Strong expertise in Jira and Confluence project management tools required, preferred experience in Microsoft Project, Smartsheet or other similar tools.
Experience managing project budgets, vendor SOWs, and implementation partners.
Strong risk, issue, and change management skills, including organizational change and user adoption.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with strong presentation skills and the ability to convey complex technical topics clearly to executive and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to influence and drive results without direct authority in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.
Exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with a high level of attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the automotive aftermarket or other high-volume wholesale distribution, supply chain, or logistics environments.
Experience delivering AI capabilities embedded in enterprise platforms (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, Oracle Fusion, Workday).
Familiarity with AI governance and Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF).
Experience working within a PMO in a geographically dispersed, multi-site environment.
Experience operating within a parent-company or portfolio-company governance structure.

Education / Certifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
PMP (Project Management Professional) certification required.
Agile certification (e.g., PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe) preferred; AI-related certifications (e.g., Azure AI, AWS AI/ML, PMI-CPMAI) are a plus.

new_jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Re-architecting Engineering for the Age of Intelligence

PhysicsX is the physics AI company for industrials. The company’s mission is to accelerate hardware innovation by overhauling what industrial engineering and manufacturing look like today. PhysicsX is building a new simulation software stack to deliver deep physics AI enablement across the entire engineering lifecycle. The company partners with leading organisations in aerospace & defence, automotive, semiconductors, materials, and energy & renewables, supporting them on some of their most critical and complex challenges. PhysicsX is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with offices in London, New York, and Singapore and an expanding presence in the Bay Area.

Who we are looking for

As a customer-facing Deployment Strategist (internally we call these Delivery Engineers), you are a relationship builder and technical guide who is passionate about growing strategic accounts by transforming AI solutions into lasting customer partnerships. Due to the deep technical nature of the environment we work in, you are someone who can understand advanced engineering concepts across multiple industries and excel at working directly with customers to understand their challenges, ambitions, and evolving needs while serving as their primary point of contact.

We welcome diverse technical backgrounds that bring valuable perspectives to our product. You may come from a Data Science/Machine Learning background with deep understanding of the end-to-end AI/ML product lifecycle, enabling you to explain complex technical concepts to stakeholders and identify new areas of application. Alternatively, you may have an engineering profile bringing domain-specific engineering understanding that helps connect our solutions to real industry challenges. In either case, you bring a unique perspective and you help customers bridge the gap between advanced AI capabilities and practical engineering applications. Note that your current role might not leverage your technical background - for example you might have left the field of engineering but are interesting in returning! You are a keen learner who will become up-to-speed with our core technology stack, cloud/software deployment, and product features, allowing you to support customers with guiding activities and technical requests.

With 4+ years industry experience in a commercial, customer-facing environment, you're ready to take ownership of the complete customer journey, from onboarding and change management to roadmap planning and contract preparation. You excel at strategic planning, time management, and problem-solving, with natural organizational skills that enable you to manage sprint planning, deliverables alignment, and smooth project delivery. Experience in industrial or advanced manufacturing sectors—such as automotive, semiconductors, or materials—is preferred.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll work closely with both customers and our Simulation Engineers, Software Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Data Scientists to understand and define the engineering and physics challenges we are build solutions for. You will:

Build and maintain relationships with users and senior decision-makers at our customers
Run the account operating rhythm: executive reviews, account reporting, and tracking of delivery progress and value
Own the customer onboarding journey and drive change management, making sure what we build gets adopted and creates measurable value
Track adoption and engagement, working side-by-side with customers to collect signal and feedback
Support the running of customer delivery teams, including onboarding of embedded team members, team health surveys, and customer satisfaction (NPS)
Build AI-enabled tooling to make account operations faster and more scalable
Support new business development on the account and in adjacent semiconductor opportunities, including identifying problems and stakeholders, preparing proposals, and supporting contracting
Translate customer industry challenges into product feedback for the product team

Our delivery teams drive innovation to turn AI models into practical solutions - read our blog to learn more about how you’ll contribute to this exciting journey!
https://www.physicsx.ai/newsroom/how-delivery-makes-physical-ai-work-in-the-real-world

What We Offer

Equity options – share in our success and growth.
5% 401(k) contribution – invest in your future.
Flexible working – balance your work and life in a way that works for you.
Hybrid setup – enjoy our Manhattan office while keeping remote flexibility.
Enhanced parental leave – support for life’s biggest milestones.
Private healthcare – comprehensive coverage for you and your family.
Personal development – access learning and training to help you grow.
Work from anywhere – extend your remote setup to enjoy the sun or reconnect with loved ones.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we're building a culture where everyone belongs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, welcoming talent of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Changing the face of tech takes action, which is why we actively encourage individuals from historically underrepresented groups to apply.

Salary Range

$90,000 - 130,000 depending on experience

Seniority will be assessed throughout our interview process.

We value diversity and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, race, religion, ethnicity, nationality, disability, age, sexual orientation or gender identity. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underrepresented in tech to apply. To help make a change, we sponsor bright women from disadvantaged backgrounds through their university degrees in science and mathematics.

5-6 years in security operations management

The Campus Security Manager (CSM)
leads a team of site security personnel, including site managers, field training officers, and security officers, and is accountable for delivering physical security-related services at one or more assigned locations within a geographic area. The CSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. The CSM partners with senior leadership and management teams in Security and Operations to drive operational effectiveness, superior performance, and audit readiness.

Position Overview

The Campus Security Manager (CSM) leads a team of site security personnel, including site managers, field training officers, and security officers, and is accountable for delivering physical security-related services at one or more assigned locations within a geographic area. The CSM is responsible for the leadership development of the individuals who report to them, while also being accountable for the delivery of security operations at these locations. The CSM partners with senior leadership and management teams in Security and Operations to drive operational effectiveness, superior performance, and audit readiness. Responsible for preserving an environment where people and property are safe and well-protected, the CSM utilizes their professional experience to manage individuals with varying skill sets and develops effective strategies to drive improvement. The CSM reports directly to the regional security manager, works alongside other site security managers in their metro area, and manages the Security Team Manager (STM).

Essential Functions

Manages physical security operations at multiple critical infrastructure facilities.
Drives safety programming for the security team with a goal of zero workplace injuries onsite.
Actively manages site security personnel; partners with the local branch to recruit and hire, oversee onboarding, training, and development at the sites.
Ensures each staff member is treated with dignity and respect.
Plans, assigns, and manages physical security projects and tasks to timely completion.
Coaches security employees and carries out disciplinary actions in accordance with current policy.
Evaluates the effectiveness of site security operations and provides recommendations for improvement.
Utilizes excellent customer service and communication skills, sets the example, and holds site security staff accountable to do the same.
Ensures site health and key performance indicator goals are met or exceeded; works with the regional security manager (RSM) to enhance security team effectiveness and performance.
Meets regularly with the client and Securitas corporate management representatives for account reviews, addresses issues in a timely manner, and supports security planning, assessments, and surveys.
Keeps management informed of major accomplishments, issues, and concerns.
Follows standardized procedures to successfully complete unannounced audits.
Builds and maintains relationships with internal and external stakeholders to maintain a safe and secure environment.
Splits time equally between sites, building familiarity with each location, leading the team, building the program, and coaching for success.

Additional Information

Job Title:
Intelligence Analyst SME (National Security Mission Support)

Location:
Vienna, VA

Clearance:
Top Secret with SCI eligibility, and ability to obtain and maintain a CI poly

Job Description

Agile Defense is seeking qualified professionals to support national security intelligence and operational analysis missions within a multi-agency federal environment. This work supports critical government efforts focused on identity resolution, threat screening, intelligence analysis, and information sharing across the U.S. national security and law enforcement community. The mission operates in a fast-paced operational environment supporting national security priorities, with teams working collaboratively across government partners to ensure timely analysis, data integrity, and operational coordination. Support may include intelligence analysis, operational support, program management, and mission coordination activities that contribute to protecting the United States from national security threats. 

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Apply expert qualitative and quantitative methods to assess and improve threat screening effectiveness and complex management systems, processes, and procedures; document best practices, train, mentor, and provide quality assurance for more junior staff

Strong analytical and research skills

Ability to work collaboratively in mission-focused environments Strong written and verbal communication skills

Experience supporting federal law enforcement, intelligence community, or national security missions

Experience working in multi-agency environments

The employee will work in a climate-controlled office environment performing desk-based duties.

Incident handling
Triage of events

Trend analysis
Metric development

DoD CNDSP methodology

Provide the Intelligence Community (IC) with priority intelligence requirements (PIR) and indications and warning requirements for potential attacks against DoD information systems and computer networks

Recommend Information Operations Conditions (INFOCON) changes in response to unauthorized activity (e.g., computer network attacks, computer network exploitation, system misuse), and to mitigate potential damage to DoD information systems and computer networks.

Technical understanding in some of the following areas: network communication using TCP/IP protocols, basic system administration, understanding of malware (malware communication installation, or malware types), Computer Network Defense operations (proxy, firewall, IDS/IPS, router/switch, or open source information collection), Joint Operational Planning Process (JOPP),
Experience in an Operations Center providing and briefing Senior Leaders on threats and mitigation actions, SITREPs, Operational Updates, statistical support, strategic plans to harden defenses, and experience as an Action Officer (AO) to lead priority efforts
Have working knowledge of threat and vulnerability analysis, routing protocols, routing, intrusion detection systems, intrusion protection systems, Domain Name Service, or network traffic analysis

Intermediate level – 4-8 years of experience
Senior level – 8-12 years of experience

DoD 8570 certification at IAT Level II, Security+ CE

Experience working with the Intelligence Community and priority intelligence requirements
Advanced communications and presentations skills (verbal and written) enabling precise conveyance of information across all CC/S/A/FA with command and proper enunciation of the English language

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Cleared
new_jobs.description:
About Aalyria

Aalyria is a leading technology company that supplies laser communications technology and temporospatial software-defined networking platforms to the aerospace industry. With technology acquired from Google, Aalyria is at the forefront of innovation in satellite and airborne mesh networks, as well as cislunar and deep-space communications. We are revolutionizing the orchestration and management of planetary mesh networks using any radio or optical spectrum, any orbit, and any hardware across land, sea, air, and space.

Role Overview

Aalyria's Spacetime platform orchestrates highly dynamic aerospace networks using a temporospatial Software Defined Networking (SDN) approach, managing not just routing but the physical link topology and lower-layer configuration underneath it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to own execution on one of our most sensitive customer programs, work that requires an active TS/SCI clearance

, with a polygraph strongly preferred given the access levels involved. You'll be the linchpin between Aalyria's engineering teams and a cleared government customer, driving technical tradeoffs directly rather than simply tracking them. Engineering will look to you to make sequencing, scope, and architecture-adjacent calls, and to represent program status and risk with complete accuracy to customer stakeholders who may not always have full visibility into every technical detail.

This is a role for someone who can operate independently inside a classified environment, hold their own in a room with Staff or Principal engineers, and get things done through influence rather than authority.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Technical Program Execution: Own program planning and execution for a classified Spacetime engineering effort, driving the work through each phase of the mission and directly resolving cross-system dependencies and technical tradeoffs, not just surfacing them for others to decide.
Cleared Customer & Stakeholder Leadership: Serve as the primary programmatic interface with a cleared government customer, communicating fluently with both technical staff and senior government stakeholders across classified and unclassified channels.
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Run the operating rhythm, such as kickoffs, technical reviews, exec readouts, that keeps Engineering, Product, and Solutions Engineering aligned on status, risk, and decisions across compartmented and uncompartmented workstreams.
Requirements Translation & Technical Judgment: Translate customer and mission requirements into actionable engineering plans. You should be able to read and critique a design document unaided, and reason in real time about latency, throughput, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs.
Security & Compliance Stewardship: Handle classified information and CUI correctly as a matter of course, maintain a sound personal security posture, and follow program security and export-control (ITAR/EAR) requirements without needing to be reminded. Partner closely with the FSO and IT/Cybersecurity, who are direct stakeholders in how this role is evaluated.
Contract & Financial Management: Own T&M or cost-type contract reporting requirements, including monthly labor, subcontract, hardware, and materials tracking at the Master Equipment List (MEL) level to support invoicing.
Risk & Delivery Coordination: Identify schedule, scope, and dependency risk early; escalate with context; and coordinate mitigations directly with engineering leads across development, staging, and dedicated government cloud production environments.

Required Qualifications

Active TS/SCI clearance in good standing. TS/SCI with polygraph is strongly preferred given the access levels this role requires.
5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related role delivering complex technical platforms, ideally for U.S. Government or defense/space customers.
Demonstrated technical depth: the ability to read and critique a design document unaided, and to engage engineering teams on architecture, scaling, and failure-mode tradeoffs as a peer, not a translator.
A track record with genuinely technical programs, infrastructure migrations, API/interface contracts, cross-system dependency resolution, or multi-team technical rollouts, not just cross-functional coordination with a technical flavor.
Proven ability to influence without authority and interface confidently with senior government and customer stakeholders.
Experience managing complex project financials, resource tracking, or strict contractual reporting requirements (T&M, FFP, or cost-type contracts).
U.S. citizenship (required to hold and maintain the clearance level above).
Background in engineering, hardware/software systems, or solutions architecture, or a related field with hands-on experience running technical programs alongside engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with networking, telecom, or SDN/traffic engineering concepts.
Strong background in satellite and mission operations — early-orbit commissioning, fleet readiness, or operating in high-consequence environments.
Experience supporting programs that have transitioned from prototype to production volumes, and improving TRL/MRL along the way.
In-depth knowledge of USG acquisition processes, FAR/DFARS, and contract vehicles (BAAs, sole-source, IDIQs, OTAs).
Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, or a related technical field — preferred, not mandatory. Equivalent hands-on technical experience is evaluated on equal footing.
Willingness to travel occasionally as program needs require.

Compensation

The base salary for this role is $187,000 – $207,000, which may vary by geographic location. Compensation also includes a competitive equity grant, an annual performance bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Your final offer will reflect your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

What We Offer

Innovative Environment: Work at a cutting-edge company shaping the future of aerospace communications.
Impactful Work: Directly contribute to critical national security programs and initiatives.
Growth Opportunities: Expand your career with opportunities for professional development and advancement.
Inclusive Culture: Be part of a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive workplace where your contributions matter.
Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements including hybrid remote/in-office schedules.
Compensation and Equity: Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits (401(k), dental, vision, health, life insurance), paid time off, and equity options.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position involves access to export-controlled information. To comply with U.S. government export regulations, applicants must meet one of the following criteria:

Qualify as a U.S. person, which includes:
U.S. citizen or national
U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder)
Refugee under 8 U.S.C. 1157
Asylee under 8 U.S.C. 1158
Be eligible to access export-controlled information without requiring an export authorization.
Be eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the necessary export authorization from the appropriate U.S. government agency.

The company reserves the right to decline pursuing an export licensing process for legitimate business-related reasons.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Aalyria is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Qualified applicants from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

187,000 - 207,000 USD per year (Remote (DC, US))
